name: duizuo-reading-companion
title_zh: 读书记不住进度？它替你记着，还防剧透
tagline_zh: 小说、散文、非虚构都能陪读。它记住你读到哪、什么感受，下次接着聊，绝不提前剧透。读不下去时，它会问你怎么了。
tagline_en: For novels, essays, nonfiction. It tracks where you are and how you feel, picks up next time, and won't spoil a.
desc_en: Stateful, spoiler-safe reading companionship for novels, short-story and essay collections, mixed anthologies, and nonfiction. Use when the reader is preparing to read, reading, stuck, reacting, interpreting, evaluating, or debriefing a book. It remembers edition, medium, status, and content-appropriate progress; verifies text claims; adapts each turn to plot, emotion, aesthetics, interpretation,
why_zh: 它把读书变成有状态的对话：记得版本、媒介、进度，还能验证文本细节。每次回应都贴合当下情节。
why_en: Stateful, spoiler-safe reading chats. It remembers edition, medium, and progress, verifies text claims, and adapts to plot.
limit_zh: 只支持文本类书籍，不处理有声书或视频；需要你主动汇报进度，它不会自动翻页；对长篇复杂情节的跨章记忆有限。
limit_en: Text-only; no audiobooks/video. You must report progress; it won't auto-sync. Cross-chapter memory is limited; very long books may need manual resets.
title_en: A reading companion that remembers your place and never.
